title: MIT Republic of China (Taiwan) Student Association
content_html:
The MIT Republic of China (Taiwan) Student Association, known as MIT ROCSA, is an MIT-sponsored, student-run organization serving Taiwanese students, researchers, faculty, and their families at MIT and in the greater Boston area. The organization describes itself on its website as a community for students who come from the Republic of China (Taiwan), with a mission focused on connection, mutual support, and cultural introduction to the wider MIT community.

ROCSA holds a wide variety of events year-round, including group outings, festival celebrations, sports activities, and career panels. The organization also provides practical support to newcomers, including pre-departure workshops and assistance with housing arrangements for students relocating to Cambridge. While ATS at MIT primarily serves undergraduates, ROCSA’s Facebook page identifies it as a social club for Taiwanese graduate students, making it the principal Taiwanese student organization for MIT’s graduate and research community. The organization publishes a student handbook — most recently updated in 2025 — to help incoming Taiwanese students navigate life at MIT and in Boston.
